title: Wavy vase
description: A vase or plant-pot cover whose wall waves and twists, drawn from a formula: r = R (1 + depth x cos(waves x t)), each height turned a little further. Set the diameters, the height and the belly, the number and depth of the waves and the twist. The model is solid: print it in your slicer's vase mode (spiralize outer contour) for a thin, watertight wall with a closed bottom. Export it with File > Export... (STL or 3MF).
